newsitem.title: USA: American Radio names new director.
newsitem.headline: American Radio names new director.

text.p: American Radio Systems Corp said on Thursday that Lance Primis, a former president and chief operating officer of the New York Times Co, is joining the company's board of directors.
Primis replaces Donald Hebb Jr., who recently resigned from the board.
The addition of Primis is subject to the approval of the company's shareholders at the 1997 annual meeting on May 29th, American Radio Systems said.
Primis was named president and general manager of the New York Times in 1988 and served as president and chief operating officer of the parent company from 1992 through 1996, American Radio said.
